title: MovieAgent shot-plan adapter contract (interface sketch, MIT)
purpose: Defines the data contract between MovieAgent's shot-plan output (arXiv 2503.07314v1) and a downstream image/video generator. Typed Python dataclasses for the character bank and shot entry, a pre-generation validator, and a prompt serialiser. Interface sketch only; not a tested integration.
attribution: Wu, Zhu and Shou, 'Automated Movie Generation via Multi-Agent CoT Planning', arXiv:2503.07314v1, CC BY 4.0 - plan-field table shapes used as source for data contract
